title: Indexes are not used efficiently
symptom: xDrip gets slower over time as the database grows, indicating that indexes are not used efficiently.
cause: The thread suggests that the lack of running the ANALYZE command on the SQLite database may lead to outdated index statistics, causing the query optimizer to not use indexes effectively.
fix: The thread suggests running ANALYZE on database connection close, and possibly revising the ORM layer and queries. A later comment references a pull request #2052 as providing a solution.
evidence_quote: As far as I can tell, we never run the ANALYZE command, so maybe running it is a good thing.
